articles.title: Nancy Lemann’s Wasted Youths
articles.dek: Youth may be wasted on the young, but what if the young are already wasted? The writer Nancy Lemann coined the term “wastrel-youth contingent” to describe characters who squander their early adulthood and pickle themselves in gin.
